senses.gloss:
अहृणान अ-हृणान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not
being angry, friendly.

अ-हृणीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not being angry,
jealous, or envious; not discontented, willing; that
which is bestowed willingly.

अहृद्य अ-हृद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not desired, not
agreeable.
—अहृद्य-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, disagreeable, caus-
ing disgust.

आहृ आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्,
to fetch, bring, bring near, give; to recover, bring
back; to get, take; to offer in sacrifice: Caus. P.
-हारयति, -यितुम्, to make one pay or give or
fetch or bring; to exact; to exert, exhibit: Desid.
A. -जिहीर्षते, to seek to recover or get back.

आ-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought, taken, collected.
—आहृत-यज्ञ-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. intending
(to offer) a prepared sacrifice; preparing a sacrificial
act (?).

आ-हृत्य, ind. having taken or received, having
brought.
